title: NUS student, strict commute + tight budget
persona: Rahul, 20, undergrad at NUS (Kent Ridge). Lives on a scholarship budget.
situation: Hard constraint on commute time to NUS, but his budget is low for the areas near campus.

turns.content: I need a room near NUS. I must be able to reach Kent Ridge within 30 minutes.
My budget is $850. Common room is fine.
Hmm, everything near campus looks more expensive than that. What are my options?
If I stretch to $1000, does that open up much more? What would you recommend I do?
